title: Back Me Up
desc: Arm a backup audio track, listen via mic, and take over instantly if the main amplifier cuts out. Audio stays on device.

changelog.notes: Reject far teleport hits; gap-seed only near clock; proximity-biased tile ranking (log #1 fix)
Silent-track mode: low conf + 10s+ gap → wait for next burst marker; live Heard roll between spots
Skip track silence on trigger/search; widen micro-hunt when confidence mid/low; slip toward better score
Post-lock Heard clips + micro-align under 95%; freeze track dB peak; shared Heard/Track levels; spot checks at ≥95%
Delay clock until amp audio; cutout slip on auto-resume; silence-gap search seed; Reset zeros Amp/Backup; softer edge cutouts
Heard wave always visible (local bars); coverage soft when score/idf pass; near-miss keeps streak

Softer lock (gaps soft, near-miss streak), forward-wide search, Play track / Reset in Settings, playback seek/mute/volume, auto-resume on cutout when audio returns, Heard viz cleanup, settings expand while locked
Tiled fingerprint matching (10 s tiles) for uneven hash density
Burst-bounded clips, cutout cooldown after lock, cutout event logging
Pill-bar mic meter, settings lock disables controls, sticky strong-lock, release notes blurb
Unified Back me up button (user-clocked track + trail), wide search after repeated misses
